description: Send a demo request to the Wai team for a clinic, on the person's behalf and with their agreement. The team replies by email within 1 working day. Needs the person's name, work email and clinic name; city and a message are optional.

email.description: Their work email. The reply goes here.

message.description: What they want to see, or what their days are like. Optional.

name.description: Full name of the person asking.

role.description: Optional: clinic owner, clinician, practice manager or other.

name: request_demo
title: Request a demo of Wai
